title: Power Tools & Electric Motors
painPoint: Brushless DC (BLDC) motors in cordless power tools demand NdFeB magnets with maximum energy product (BHmax) above 50 MGOe while sustaining coercivity under aggressive thermal loads up to 150 degrees C. High-speed operation exceeding 30,000 RPM creates significant centrifugal stress on sintered magnet rings, risking micro-cracking and irreversible demagnetization. Impact-resistant magnet assemblies must survive repeated mechanical shock in hammer drills and impact drivers. Manufacturers struggle sourcing consistent N48 to N52 grades that maintain flux density after prolonged thermal cycling, particularly in compact tool housings where cooling capacity is severely limited.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU provides high-performance NdFeB magnets including N52, N48SH, and 42UH grades optimized for BLDC motors in cordless drills, angle grinders, and impact drivers. Our grain boundary diffusion process elevates intrinsic coercivity (Hcj) above 21 kOe while reducing heavy rare earth consumption by up to 30 percent. Sintered ring magnets with multipole magnetization deliver superior torque density in compact stators. Every batch passes salt-spray corrosion testing (72-hour neutral salt spray) and thermal cycling validation from -40 to 180 degrees C.
